_comment: Local dev manifest served by scripts/serve-updates.mjs on port 8787. The Tauri updater plugin will hit this file. The signature below is a placeholder — it will fail the signature check, which is what you want for local dev: it proves the chain works (manifest fetch, version compare, signature check) without actually installing a real bundle. For an end-to-end install test, replace the signature with the real value produced by `tauri signer sign` against a real bundle and place the bundle at the same path.
